svg.title: System landscape
svg.desc: The people (sangat and students, Granthis and scholars, engineers), the three surfaces they use (website, iOS app, wiki), the read-only API running as Vercel functions and the pinned database behind it, sggs-data that turns the source Bir PDF into that database, the labelled English layer, and CI as the only way anything reaches production.
